main.description: Ask the World to admit a post version authored by the service-auth issuer. The token audience is the hosted World DID or that DID with #motet_tenor, and lxm is this method. The tenor reads the version back from the author's PDS and checks the author's current membership and scene cast in the World transaction. Retry a pending result with the same op.

op.description: Caller-chosen operation ID, unique for this author; a retry must use the same ID and input.

replaces.description: For an edit, the previously admitted version this replaces.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated author lacks current World membership.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: The fetched post belongs to another World.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The operation ID was reused for a different request.
